answer: Resist Sybils by aging each identity through a sequential delay function no farm can parallelize. A new account starts at the nadir of influence, with no votes or rewards. To climb, it must finish a chain of delay puzzles, each seeded by the previous output, so progress takes real wall-clock time, one identity at a time. Picture each agent slowly ascending a knoll; the next puzzle stays hidden until the last is solved. Only then does it earn an ivory credential marking a mature identity. An attacker wanting a thousand fakes must pay a thousandfold waiting time; honest agents pay it once.
